CERTIFICATION OF REPRESENTATIVE
A Representation election has been conducted in the above
matter by the undersigned agent of the Employment Relations Board,
and it appears from the Tally of Ballots that a collective bargaining
representative has been selected and challenges and/or objections to
the election which were timely filed have been resolved. Therefore,
(T IS HEREBY CERTIFIED THAT
INTERNATIONAL UNION OF OPERATING ENGINEERS, LOCAL 701
has been designated and selected by a majority of the public employ­ees
of the above-named employer to be their exclusive representative
for the purpose of collective bargaining in the unit described below:
All hourly paid employees, di tchriders, equipment opera­tors,
mechanics, welders, laborers, truck drivers, sprayers
and helpers employed by the Vale, Oregon Irrigation Dis­trict,
excluding temporary employees, and supervisory and
confidential employees as defined by ORS 243. 650 ( 6) and (14).
